description: National e-waste monitor of Lebanon is a data set listed in Open Data Lebanon, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Lebanon. This report examines the overall statistics of electronic and electrical equipment (EEE) placed on the market (POM), the national stock and its subsequent e-was. Coverage: Lebanon. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Lebanon. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odl-portal.
